user_prompt: For a district-heating operator, compare continuing existing heat supply with investing in data-centre heat recovery. Preserve the heat-pump electricity boundary, match heat within each period, and calculate annual net savings, incremental NPV and break-even avoided heat cost. Stress heat demand and electricity prices. Identify missing measurements and contracts before any investment decision.

role_mandates.evidence_contract: Validate classifications, dates, units and missing inputs; never treat planned heat output as measured heat sales.
role_mandates.liquid_cooling_engineer: Use heat_balance to reconcile source heat plus pump input with delivered heat and losses. Flag temperature, seasonal and hourly evidence gaps. Do not authorize cooling or district-network controls.
role_mandates.project_finance_analyst: Use screen_heat_reuse on the verified thermal handoff. Avoid only marginal existing heat cost. Include incremental electricity, heat-source fees, variable and fixed O&M and initial CAPEX. Do not count server electricity twice.
role_mandates.energy_orchestrator: Delegate evidence, then thermal, then finance. Only ready task IDs may run. Return rejected and blocked states honestly.

input_schema: case.json v1.0. Synthetic real CHF, ISO source/event/as_of dates, nonempty limitations/gaps. 1..8760 unique periods summing to 8760 hours; constant MW and COP per period. Numeric finite nonboolean inputs: load and recovery fractions 0..1, delivery efficiency (0,1], COP 1.01..20, positive period hours; nonnegative MW and costs; 1..50 years; discount 0..1. Limits enforced by validate_case.
allowed_tools: edi_crosscheck (optional pinned local method; no retrieval)
evidence_requirements: Primary announcement URL and separate event/publication dates
Actual project targets remain source metadata; operating and economic assumptions labelled synthetic
No realised savings, emissions reduction or LLM benchmark inferred
handoffs: Evidence-approved case to existing liquid_cooling_engineer role
Input-bound heat balance to existing project_finance_analyst role
Human diligence on measurements, costs, permits and contracts
output_contract: Input SHA256, source/assumption labels and unresolved evidence
Period energy ledger and annual totals in MWh
Baseline and intervention annual CHF cost; incremental NPV and break-even avoided CHF/MWh
Annual matching ceiling labelled as upper bound, not served energy
Investment not authorized; human review required; LLM cost/latency/tokens unknown
acceptance: Invalid evidence blocks thermal and finance
Heat conservation and demand/capacity bounds pass
Scripted workflow equals direct deterministic baseline
No new role or executable external action
Optional EDI execution has source hash, input hash and matching parity
